### Neovim version (nvim -v)

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

N/A

### Operating system/version

macOS

### Terminal name/version

iTerm2 / tmux

### $TERM environment variable

tmux-256color

### Installation

Build from source

### How to reproduce the issue

No reproduction steps yet. For now, all I know to do is enable treesitter highlighting for C, modify a C buffer, then hope you get (un)lucky.
